title: Head Office Relocation Disclosure Example
summary: A short example disclosure suitable for publication on the company website.
body: This notice is sample wording. Actual disclosure content will be posted only after internal company confirmation.
TwoMenGames may publish required notices or disclosures related to company operations on this website.
Sensitive or legally significant information, including actual office relocation details, registration changes, or address information, will be published only after internal review and confirmation.
